entries.title: Point at a task anywhere and it lights up everywhere
entries.body: Point at a crewmate, or focus its name, and its row in Tasks, its tile on the task board and every mention of its key in a card, a thread, Activity and Knowledge light up. Point at a Tasks row, a tile or a key and the crewmate gets its corner brackets. It all clears the moment you move off, and the crew keep circling at their own pace.

picture.alt: A crewmate with corner brackets and its summary, and its row in the Tasks panel lit
